explanation: The worked solution confirms all three. Around any allowed t, each integrand and its t derivative are continuous on a compact rectangle with x in [0,1]. The derivatives are 1/(2√(x+t)), x(x²−t²)/(x²+t²)², and 1/(x−t)²; their denominators remain nonzero under the stated restrictions. Thus differentiation under the integral sign is valid for I, II, and III.
